questions.prompt: He normally ___ the plants daily. (a water, b waters, c watering, d watered)
steps: He takes waters for a daily present habit.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: These women are ___ the family dishes now. (a washes, b washing, c wash, d washed)
steps: Are plus an ing verb forms present continuous.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: This dog cannot go far; it ___ a chain on its neck. (a have, b has, c is having, d had)
steps: It takes has to express possession now.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Tom and I visited Mikumi last year. ___ saw many animals. (a He, b She, c They, d We)
steps: Tom and the speaker are we.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Choose a short answer to Was she cooking Makande? (a No she was not, b Yes she was not, c No, d Yes)
steps: Repeat was and the subject in the standard grammar exercise form.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
questions.answer: a. No, she was not (expected auxiliary answer). Yes or No alone are also valid brief replies.

questions.prompt: Didn't your sister ___ you a story yesterday? (a tell, b tells, c teller, d told)
steps: After did not use the base verb tell.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: She bought bread and cakes from our neighbour's ___. (a barbershop, b greengrocer, c grocery, d bakery)
steps: A bakery produces and sells bread and cakes.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: The young ones of a goose are ___. (a goslings, b geese, c gooslings, d gosling)
steps: The plural of the young-bird name gosling is goslings.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: She sells fruits and vegetables. She is a ___. (a grocery, b florist, c fruiterer, d greengrocer)
steps: A greengrocer sells both fruit and vegetables.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Mr. and Mrs. Ezekiel own ten dairy cows. The cows belong to ___. (a them, b her, c his, d him)
steps: Two owners take the object pronoun them after to.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: A ___ receives treatment at hospital. (patient, surgeon)
steps: Patient names the person receiving medical care.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Aisha sells medicines. She is ___. (a pharmacist, a chemistry)
steps: Pharmacist is a person; chemistry is a subject.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Who diagnoses and treats patients? (nurse, doctor)
steps: The question describes the conventional role of a doctor; nurses also provide treatment within their training.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: My keys were not ___ in the cupboard. (their, there)
steps: There names a location; their shows possession.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: I do not ___ well today. (feel, fell)
steps: After do not use the base verb feel.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Our ___ barks at night. Arrange dgo.
steps: Rearrange d-g-o to dog.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: We are in the library reading ___. Arrange bkoos.
steps: Use every letter to form books.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: The hens have laid many ___. Arrange gsge.
steps: The letters make eggs, which hens lay.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: One afternoon Andrew was ___ football. (play)
steps: Was plus playing forms past continuous.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: He accidentally hit the window and ___ it. (break)
steps: The completed past event requires broke.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: His father ___ what Andrew did. (see)
steps: Saw is the simple past of see.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: His father ___ at him angrily. (shout)
steps: Add ed to form the regular past tense.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: What is a person whose parents are dead called?
steps: The passage identifies Sharon as an orphan.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Who cared for Sharon after her mother's death?
steps: The second sentence gives the carer.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: What did Sharon want to become?
steps: She tells her uncle her ambition.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: What advice did her uncle give?
steps: The passage supplies both parts of his advice.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
questions.answer: Work hard and behave well wherever she went.

questions.prompt: Where did Sharon train as a teacher?
steps: The passage names the training college.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
